articles.title: Woman Allegedly Assaulted By Daughter-In-Law, Now Women In Critical Condition.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A domestic dispute in Uttar Pradesh’s Bareilly district took a serious turn after a 58-year-old woman allegedly taken drastic step following harassment and assault by her son and daughter-in-law. The incident was reported from Malukpur area under the Kila police station limits.

body.html:
A domestic dispute in Uttar Pradesh’s Bareilly district took a serious turn after a 58-year-old woman allegedly taken drastic step following harassment and assault by her son and daughter-in-law.

The incident was reported from Malukpur area under the Kila police station limits. The victim, identified as Anupam Rastogi, is currently undergoing treatment at the district hospital, where her condition is said to be critical.

According to family members, disputes had been ongoing in the household over property and ownership of the family house. At the district hospital, Anupam’s husband Rajiv Rastogi alleged that their younger son and daughter-in-law wanted control of the house, leading to frequent arguments.

He further claimed that the couple had assaulted family members on multiple occasions in the past and complaints had also been lodged at Kila police station, but no strict action was taken.

On Wednesday, the dispute escalated again, during which the daughter-in-law allegedly assaulted Anupam Rastogi. Disturbed by the incident, she reportedly taken drastic step.

As her health deteriorated, her husband and younger daughter rushed her to the district hospital for treatment.

Meanwhile, a video allegedly showing Anupam Rastogi being beaten by her daughter-in-law has gone viral on social media, triggering outrage online.

After the complaint filed by Rajiv Rastogi and the circulation of the viral video, police took cognisance of the matter and initiated action against the accused son and daughter-in-law.

#Bareilly #UttarPradesh #FamilyDispute #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Wife, Brother-In-Law Among 3 Arrested After Man Beaten To Death In Deoria Domestic Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Deoria police have arrested three people, including the deceased man’s wife, for allegedly beating him to death during a domestic dispute in Uttar Pradesh. The incident took place on May 25 in Vishunpur Kala (Mahuabari) village under the Bariyarpur police station area.

body.html:
Deoria police have arrested three people, including the deceased man’s wife, for allegedly beating him to death during a domestic dispute in Uttar Pradesh.

The incident took place on May 25 in Vishunpur Kala (Mahuabari) village under the Bariyarpur police station area. The deceased was identified as Mukesh Singh, a resident of the village.

According to police, Mukesh Singh was seriously injured after being allegedly assaulted with sticks by his wife Sangam Devi, her brother Jaiprakash alias Jiut, and their relative Aditya during a family dispute.

After the assault, Mukesh was first taken to CHC Rampur Factory for treatment. Due to his critical condition, he was later referred to the District Hospital in Deoria, where he died during treatment.

Following a complaint filed by the deceased’s brother Awadhesh Singh, police registered a case under Sections 103(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

During the investigation, police arrested all three named accused on Tuesday. The operation was carried out by a police team led by Deepak Singh.

Police also recovered sticks and iron rods allegedly used in the assault based on the identification provided by the accused.

All three accused were produced before a court on Wednesday and were sent to judicial custody.

#Deoria #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Dead Lizard Found In BHU Hostel Chicken Curry, Students Fall Sick And Stage Protest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic and protests erupted at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi after students allegedly found a dead lizard inside chicken curry served at the Dalmia hostel mess on Tuesday.

body.html:
Panic and protests erupted at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi after students allegedly found a dead lizard inside chicken curry served at the Dalmia hostel mess on Tuesday.

According to students, nearly 30 to 40 hostel residents had already consumed the food before the reptile was discovered inside the curry container. Soon after the incident came to light, several students reportedly complained of nausea and vomiting, triggering chaos inside the hostel premises.

As the news spread, angry students gathered outside the mess and staged protests against hostel authorities, accusing them of serious negligence in food quality and hygiene standards.

Videos from the hostel showed heated arguments between students and officials, while several residents surrounded the warden demanding strict action against the mess contractor.

After receiving information about the incident, the university’s proctorial board and hostel warden rushed to the spot.

Students also submitted a written complaint highlighting multiple issues related to hostel management, including poor food quality and shortage of clean drinking water.

Mess operator Arvind Chaurasia claimed that the reptile may have accidentally fallen into the food due to extreme summer conditions.

“During summers, many lizards enter the area. One of them may have fallen into the food,” he said.

However, students alleged that repeated complaints regarding hygiene and maintenance inside the hostel mess had been ignored by the administration.

The protest continued for a considerable time before authorities assured students that the mess operator would be removed and other hostel-related problems would also be addressed. Following the assurance, the protesting students dispersed peacefully.

While several students reported discomfort after the incident, no serious health complications had been reported till the filing of this report.

#BHU #Varanasi #HostelMess #BanarasHinduUniversity #StudentProtest

articles.title: Red Signal Jump, Brutal Crash, And Escape: Navi Mumbai Journalist Left Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Navi Mumbai-based journalist and women’s rights activist was seriously injured in a hit-and-run accident on Palm Beach Road after a speeding biker allegedly jumped a red signal and rammed into her scooty.

body.html:
A Navi Mumbai-based journalist and women’s rights activist was seriously injured in a hit-and-run accident on Palm Beach Road after a speeding biker allegedly jumped a red signal and rammed into her scooty.

Sandhya Jain, 56, editor of the magazines Women Zone and Kanchan Kanika, has been undergoing treatment at Apollo Hospital in Seawoods with multiple fractures, facial injuries and severe trauma.

According to Jain, the accident took place on May 18 near NRI Junction on Palm Beach Road while she was heading towards the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation headquarters in Belapur.

Speaking from her hospital bed, Jain said CCTV footage showed a biker wearing a maroon shirt allegedly jumping the red signal and crashing into her scooty while her signal was green.

She further alleged that after the collision, the biker picked up his motorcycle and fled the scene, leaving her unconscious on the road.

Police have registered an FIR against an unidentified biker for reckless driving. However, officials admitted that poor CCTV camera quality has made it difficult to identify the accused as the motorcycle registration number was not clearly captured.

Investigating officer Kiran Swar from NRI police station said police examined CCTV footage from the area, but the number plate remains unclear in the recordings.

The incident has sparked criticism over Navi Mumbai’s surveillance infrastructure, especially on busy roads like Palm Beach Road where multiple CCTV cameras are installed.

Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation Commissioner Kailas Shinde stated that while the civic body maintains the CCTV monitoring system, police are the primary users of the surveillance network for traffic enforcement and investigations.

Social activists and local residents have demanded installation of high-definition cameras with advanced identification technology to improve road safety and assist investigations.

Police said further investigation into the hit-and-run case is currently underway.

#NaviMumbai #HitAndRun #PalmBeachRoad #RoadAccident #SandhyaJain

articles.title: Speeding Car Launches Elderly Woman Into Air On Nashik-Mumbai Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nashik: A 65-year-old woman was critically injured after a speeding car hit her while she was walking along the roadside of the Nashik-Mumbai Highway. The shocking hit-and-run incident was captured on CCTV footage, which has now gone viral on social media.

body.html:
Nashik: A 65-year-old woman was critically injured after a speeding car hit her while she was walking along the roadside of the Nashik-Mumbai Highway. The shocking hit-and-run incident was captured on CCTV footage, which has now gone viral on social media.

The disturbing visuals show the elderly woman carrying water utensils on her head while walking beside the highway. Moments later, a speeding sedan appears and crashes into her with tremendous force.

The impact was so severe that the woman was flung several feet into the air before falling onto the road. Despite the serious collision, the driver did not stop to help and instead fled the scene, leaving the injured woman lying on the highway.

The exact date and time of the incident are yet to be confirmed. Authorities have also not officially disclosed the woman’s current health condition or whether an FIR has been registered against the absconding driver.

The viral CCTV footage has once again raised concerns over reckless driving and the rising number of hit-and-run incidents on highways across Maharashtra.

#Nashik #Maharashtra #HitAndRun #RoadAccident #ViralVideo

articles.title: Slab Collapse at PM Awas Housing in Bhavnagar Injures Three Youths, Residents Allege Negligence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three youths suffered serious injuries after a portion of a concrete slab suddenly collapsed in the parking area of the Ruva Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana in Bhavnagar’s Subhashnagar area late Saturday night.

body.html:
Three youths suffered serious injuries after a portion of a concrete slab suddenly collapsed in the parking area of the Ruva Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana in Bhavnagar’s Subhashnagar area late Saturday night.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV and has triggered outrage among residents, who allege that repeated complaints about the poor condition of the housing complex have been ignored by authorities.

According to reports, the accident took place around 1:15 am in the B-Wing parking area of Plot No. 28 of the housing scheme, which was handed over to beneficiaries only around four-and-a-half years ago.

At the time of the incident, three youths were reportedly sitting on a motorcycle in the parking lot when a large portion of the slab suddenly collapsed directly onto them. All three sustained injuries and were rushed to hospital for treatment.

Residents claimed that cracks, gaps, and structural issues have been appearing frequently in the housing complex, especially during the monsoon season, raising serious safety concerns.

Local resident Falguniben Dabhi said residents have repeatedly approached authorities regarding the condition of the buildings but no permanent solution has been provided.

“We are middle-class families who somehow managed to get these houses. Incidents like this keep happening, especially during monsoon. We have children at home and are living in fear,” she said.

Another resident, Vimal Dabhi, alleged that several complaints and applications had already been submitted to the Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation (BMC), but no proper inspection or repair work had been carried out.

The viral CCTV footage shows the slab collapsing suddenly while the youths were seated below, creating panic among nearby residents.

The incident has once again raised questions about the construction quality and maintenance of government housing projects.

Authorities are yet to issue a detailed statement regarding the cause of the collapse. Further investigation is underway.

#Bhavnagar #PMAwasYojana #Gujarat #SlabCollapse #CCTV

articles.title: “Sunroof Reel Turns Costly”: BMW Seized After Girl Filmed Dancing on Moving Car in Bilaspur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video from Chhattisgarh’s Bilaspur has landed a BMW owner in police trouble after a girl was seen dancing through the sunroof of the speeding luxury car on a highway while filming videos on her mobile phone.

body.html:
A viral video from Chhattisgarh’s Bilaspur has landed a BMW owner in police trouble after a girl was seen dancing through the sunroof of the speeding luxury car on a highway while filming videos on her mobile phone.

According to reports, the incident took place on the Bilaspur–Raipur highway under the Chakarbhatta police station area.

The viral clip allegedly shows the BMW being driven recklessly at high speed while the girl stood through the open sunroof, dancing and recording videos for social media.

After the video surfaced online, Bilaspur Police took cognisance and initiated action against the vehicle owner.

Police said the BMW, bearing registration number CG 10 CA 3999, is registered in the name of Prateek Luther, a resident of Om Zone Shubham Vihar Mangala.

The luxury car has now been seized, and Prateek Luther was called to the police station for questioning.

According to police officials, the accused admitted to violating traffic rules while driving on the highway on May 24, 2026. Authorities said further legal action is being taken in the matter.

Officials also stated that reckless driving and stunt-related traffic violations have repeatedly surfaced in Bilaspur despite earlier crackdowns. The matter has even drawn attention from the Bilaspur High Court in the past.

The viral video was reportedly recorded by a passerby travelling on the same highway. Police said the stunt could have led to a serious road accident.

#Bilaspur #Chhattisgarh #BMW #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Dragged Into Car After Brutal Beating”: Daylight Abduction Caught on Camera in Bhopal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational case of assault and alleged abduction in broad daylight has come to light from Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal, where a youth was brutally beaten and forcibly taken away in a car near Prabhat Petrol Pump under the Ashoka Garden police station limits.

body.html:
A sensational case of assault and alleged abduction in broad daylight has come to light from Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal, where a youth was brutally beaten and forcibly taken away in a car near Prabhat Petrol Pump under the Ashoka Garden police station limits.

The entire incident was captured on mobile phones by people present at the spot, and the video has now gone viral on social media.

The footage allegedly shows a group of youths stopping the victim in the middle of the road and assaulting him publicly before forcing him into a car and fleeing from the scene.

Following the circulation of the video online, police launched an immediate investigation.

According to police, preliminary inquiry revealed that the accused and the victim had an old rivalry, and the attack was allegedly carried out to settle that dispute.

Using the viral footage and the vehicle registration number, Bhopal Police identified and arrested the accused. Officials also confirmed that the abducted youth was rescued safely.

Police Commissioner Sanjay Kumar said the accused were seen forcibly taking away the victim after assaulting him, following which swift action was taken to trace and arrest them.

A case has been registered under sections related to kidnapping, assault, and other serious offences. Police said interrogation of the accused is ongoing.

The incident has triggered concern over law and order in the state capital, with many social media users expressing shock over the brazen daylight attack.

#Bhopal #MadhyaPradesh #Kidnapping #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Caught on CCTV”: Four Women Arrested Within 24 Hours for Saree Shop Theft in Aligarh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh arrested four women within 24 hours for allegedly stealing sarees from a shop in Iglas town. The entire incident was captured on nearby CCTV cameras.

body.html:
Police in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh arrested four women within 24 hours for allegedly stealing sarees from a shop in Iglas town. The entire incident was captured on nearby CCTV cameras.

According to police, the theft took place at Vanshika Saree Emporium located in Shiva Market, owned by Jitendra, a resident of Lalpur Colony in Iglas.

The shop owner alleged that a group of women stole sarees from the store on Monday. After reviewing CCTV footage installed near the shop, he approached police and lodged a complaint.

Following the complaint, a police team was formed under directions issued by Aligarh SSP Neeraj Jadon, who has instructed officials to take strict action against rising theft incidents in the district.

On Tuesday morning, police arrested four accused women near Double Canal New Colony in the Kotwali area. The accused were identified as Ramadevi, Munni Devi, Savitri Devi, and Urmila Devi, all residents of Pathua village in Hathras district.

Police said 12 stolen sarees were recovered from their possession.

Iglas Inspector Dinesh Kumar Sisodiya confirmed that a case has been registered under relevant sections and the accused women have been produced before the court.

Further investigation is underway.

#Aligarh #UttarPradesh #Theft #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Caught on CCTV”: Speeding Truck Crushes Biker on NH-44 in Lalitpur, Another Critical
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident on National Highway-44 in Uttar Pradesh’s Lalitpur claimed the life of a biker and left another seriously injured after a speeding truck allegedly rammed into them while they were crossing the highway. The entire incident was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A tragic road accident on National Highway-44 in Uttar Pradesh’s Lalitpur claimed the life of a biker and left another seriously injured after a speeding truck allegedly rammed into them while they were crossing the highway. The entire incident was captured on CCTV.

According to reports, the deceased has been identified as Tinku alias Dinesh (38). Both men were reportedly returning home from nearby agricultural fields when the accident occurred.

CCTV footage shows the two bikers attempting to cross the busy highway without allegedly checking for oncoming traffic. Moments later, a truck approaching at high speed crashed into the motorcycle.

One of the victims died on the spot due to severe injuries, while the other was rushed to a nearby hospital, where he is currently undergoing treatment.

Police reached the scene soon after the accident and registered a case. Officials said an investigation is underway to determine the exact sequence of events and whether negligence was involved from either side.

The viral CCTV footage has also sparked discussion on social media, with many users stressing the importance of following traffic rules while crossing highways.

#Lalitpur #RoadAccident #NH44 #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews
